# dokploy_user (Data Source)

Fetches a single user from Dokploy by ID or email. Use this to look up user details for permission management.

## Example Usage

```hcl
# Look up user by ID
data "dokploy_user" "by_id" {
  user_id = "abc123"
}

# Look up user by email
data "dokploy_user" "by_email" {
  email = "user@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) The email to look up. Mutually exclusive with user_id.
- `user_id` (String) The user ID to look up. Mutually exclusive with email.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp of the user.
- `email_verified` (Boolean) Whether the user's email is verified.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the user.
- `image` (String) The profile image URL of the user.
- `is_registered` (Boolean) Whether the user has completed registration.
- `name` (String) The name of the user.
- `role` (String) The role of the user.
- `two_factor_enabled` (Boolean) Whether two-factor authentication is enabled.
